description: A shell script for automating end-to-end testing and updates of OpenClaw across multiple platforms (macOS, Windows, Linux) using Parallels virtual machines. It handles setup, baseline snapshots, update procedures, monitoring, and reporting.

methods.name: say
methods.description: Prints a message with a prefix to standard output.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Prints a warning message to standard error.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Prints an error message to standard error and exits.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes temporary directories and kills background server process.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: resolve_linux_vm_name
methods.description: Resolves the appropriate Linux VM name using Parallels CLI and matching logic.

methods.name: resolve_latest_version
methods.description: Fetches the latest version of the openclaw package from npm.

methods.name: resolve_host_ip
methods.description: Detects the host IP address in the Parallels environment.

methods.name: allocate_host_port
methods.description: Allocates a free host port for serving files.

methods.name: ensure_current_build
methods.description: Builds current source code before creating a package.

methods.name: pack_main_tgz
methods.description: Creates a tarball of the current source code with current git revision information.

methods.name: write_windows_update_script
methods.description: Generates a PowerShell script for window update steps.

methods.name: start_server
methods.description: Starts an HTTP server to serve the generated tarball.

methods.name: wait_job
methods.description: Waits for background job completion and logs output.

methods.name: extract_log_progress
methods.description: Extracts progress updates from a log file.

methods.name: dump_log_tail
methods.description: Outputs the tail of a log file for diagnostics.

methods.name: monitor_jobs_progress
methods.description: Monitors multiple background jobs, providing progress updates.

methods.name: extract_last_version
methods.description: Extracts the last version number from update logs.

methods.name: guest_powershell
methods.description: Runs a PowerShell script inside the guest Windows VM.

methods.name: host_timeout_exec
methods.description: Runs a command with a timeout.

methods.name: guest_powershell_poll
methods.description: Polls a PowerShell command inside the guest Windows VM with a timeout.

methods.name: run_windows_script_via_log
methods.description: Runs a remote Windows update script via temporary files and polls status.

methods.name: run_macos_update
methods.description: Performs update on macOS VM via script execution.

methods.name: run_windows_update
methods.description: Performs update on Windows VM via a remote script.

methods.name: run_linux_update
methods.description: Performs update on Linux VM via script execution.

methods.name: write_summary_json
methods.description: Generates a JSON summary report of the update process.
